# **II. Software Requirement Specification**

## **1\. Product Overview** {#1.-product-overview}

ManabiHub is a web-based Japanese e-learning marketplace that connects Students and freelance Teachers. The platform provides course marketplace functions, interactive modular lessons, context-aware AI chatbot support, AI writing feedback, AI credit control, escrow-based payment settlement, refund governance, teacher KYC, and admin moderation.

### **1.3 User Requirements**  {#1.3-user-requirements}

#### ***1.3.1 Actors***  {#1.3.1-actors}

| \# | Actor | Actor Role | Type | Description |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | ----- |
| 1 | Guest | Primary | Human | Unauthenticated visitor who can register/login and search/view public course information. Guests cannot use AI features in MVP. |
| 2 | Student | Primary | Human | Learners who can purchase courses, study lessons, use AI features, submit writing, review purchased courses, report violations, request refunds, and top up AI credits. |
| 3 | Teacher | Primary | Human | Freelance instructor who submits KYC, creates courses, publishes approved courses, reviews writing feedback, monitors analytics, and withdraws revenue. |
| 4 | System Admin | Primary | Human | Platform operator who configures policies, reviews KYC, moderates courses/reports, handles refund disputes, reviews reconciliation, and executes payout settlement. |
| 5 | Payment Gateway | Supporting | External System | External payment/refund/payout processor that returns transaction result and webhook confirmation. |
| 6 | AI Provider | Supporting | External System | External AI service used for contextual chatbot and asynchronous writing assessment. |
| 7 | Notification Service | Supporting | External System | External/internal notification delivery mechanism for email/in-app reminders. |
| 8  | VNPT eKYC Provider  | Supporting | External System | External identity verification service used to verify Teacher identity documents, selfie/liveness data, and return verification/risk results for Admin KYC review.  |

## **2\. Use Case Specifications**  {#2.-use-case-specifications}

### **2.1 Use Case List** {#2.1-use-case-list}

| Use Case ID | Use Case Name | Short Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| UC-01 | Complete Student Profile Setup | First-time public user completes basic Student profile after Google login. |
| UC-02 | Login to Public Site with Google | Guest logs in to the public learning platform using Google OAuth. |
| UC-03 | Login to Admin Portal | System Admin logs in to the separate administration site using a pre-created username/email and password. |
| UC-04 | Manage Profile | Student or Teacher views and updates own public profile information. |
| UC-05 | Search Courses | Guest or Student searches published Japanese courses by keyword and filters. |
| UC-06 | View Course Detail | Guest or Student views details, preview, teacher profile, ratings, and purchase options. |
| UC-07 | Manage Wishlist | Student saves, views, filters, and removes courses from the wishlist. |
| UC-08 | Purchase Course | Student purchases a course and receives access only after backend payment confirmation. |
| UC-09 | View Purchase History | Student views own orders, payment states, refund states, and order details. |
| UC-10 | Study Course Lessons | Student studies purchased course lessons and completes learning blocks. |
| UC-11 | Track Learning Progress | Student views course completion, quiz results, writing results, Final Test eligibility, and certificate eligibility. |
| UC-12 | Complete Learning Quiz / Final Test | Student completes lesson quizzes and the course Final Test when eligible. |
| UC-13 | Review Vocabulary Flashcards | Student reviews vocabulary/Kanji flashcards inside a lesson module. |
| UC-14 | Submit Writing Assignment | Student submits Japanese writing for AI-assisted assessment when the course is AI-supported. |
| UC-15 | View Writing Feedback | Student views AI and teacher feedback for writing submissions. |
| UC-16 | Ask AI Chatbot | Student asks contextual questions about the current lesson when the course is AI-supported. |
| UC-17 | Manage My Wallet | Student or Teacher views wallet balance and transaction history; Student can top up money balance, while Teacher can view revenue balance. |
| UC-18 | Request Course Refund | Student requests refunds and tracks refund/dispute status. |
| UC-19 | Review Purchased Course | Student creates, edits, or deletes own review for purchased courses. |
| UC-20 | Report Course Violation | Logged-in Student or Teacher reports copyright, policy, or content violation. |
| UC-21 | View Notifications | Student, Teacher, or System Admin views own notifications and updates read status. |
| UC-22 | Submit KYC Documents | Teacher submits identity/professional documents and copyright agreement. |
| UC-23 | Create and Configure Course Structure | Teacher creates and configures course metadata, modules, lessons, and Final Test after KYC approval. |
| UC-24 | View Course Analytics | Teacher views analytics for courses they own. |
| UC-25 | Publish Course | Teacher submits a validated course for Admin approval and publishes it after approval. |
| UC-26 | Override AI Feedback | Teacher reviews AI writing feedback and finalizes the score/comment. |
| UC-27 | Withdraw Teacher Revenue | Teacher requests withdrawal from available wallet balance. |
| UC-28 | Review Teacher KYC | System Admin approves, rejects, or requests correction for teacher KYC. |
| UC-29 | Approve Course Publication | System Admin reviews submitted course and approves/rejects publication. |
| UC-30 | Resolve Violation Report | System Admin investigates reports and applies moderation actions. |
| UC-31 | Configure System Settings | System Admin configures commission, price floor, AI support price floor, refund, escrow, payout, and security policies. |
| UC-32 | Approve Refund Request | System Admin decides manual refund/dispute requests. |
| UC-33 | Execute Payout Settlement | System Admin reconciles and settles teacher payout. |
| UC-34 | Configure Lesson Blocks | Teacher embeds, configures, reorders, imports, or removes video, text, quiz, flashcard, and writing blocks inside lessons. |

### **2.2 Account and Access Management** {#2.2-account-and-access-management}

#### ***2.2.1 Complete Google Account Onboarding (UC-01)*** {#2.2.1-complete-google-account-onboarding-(uc-01)}

*Table 2.2: Use case description of Complete Google Account Onboarding*

| Use Case ID | UC-01 | Use Case Name | Complete Student Profile Setup  |
| ----- | :---- | :---: | :---- |
| **Created By** | HungKT | **Created Date** |  16/06/2026 |
| **Primary Actors** | Guest | **Secondary Actors** | Google OAuth Provider |
| **Description** | As a first-time public user, I want to complete my basic Student profile after Google login so that I can start using ManabiHub as a Student.  |  |  |
| **Trigger** | A first-time Google-authenticated user is redirected to the Student profile setup screen.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. Google authentication has succeeded. 2\. No completed public profile exists for the Google account. 3\. The system assigns Student as the default public role. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | 1\. Student profile is completed. 2\. Student role is active. 3\. User is redirected to Student Home. 4\. If the user wants to become a Teacher, they must access Teacher Landing Page and submit KYC documents.  |  |  |
| **Normal Sequence/Flow** | 1\. User completes Google login. 2\. System redirects first-time user to Student Profile Setup. 3\. User enters display name, phone number, avatar, and JLPT target goal if applicable. 4\. User confirms profile setup. 5\. System validates required fields. 6\. System saves Student profile and redirects to Student Home.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Sequences/Flows** | 3a. User skips optional fields \-\> System saves required fields only. 6a. User later applies to become Teacher \-\> UC-22 Submit KYC Documents starts.  |  |  |
| **Exception** | 5a. Required field is missing \-\> System displays validation message. 5b. Invalid phone/avatar format \-\> System rejects the input.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-AUTH-01, BR-AUTH-02, BR-AUTH-05, BR-AUTH-06, BR-AUTH-08, BR-AUTH-PUBLIC-01, BR-RBAC-01, BR-KYC-02 |  |  |
| **Non-Functional Requirements** | NFR-SEC-01: OAuth token validation must be performed server-side. NFR-PERF-01: Public login/onboarding response should complete within 3 seconds excluding Google provider latency. NFR-UX-01: Role onboarding must clearly explain Student and Teacher permissions. |  |  |
| **Priority** | Must Have |  |  |

 

#### ***2.2.2 Login to Public Site with Google (UC-02)*** {#2.2.2-login-to-public-site-with-google-(uc-02)}

*Table 2.3: Use case description of Login to Public Site with Google*

| Use Case ID | UC-02 | Use Case Name | Login to Public Site with Google |
| ----- | :---- | :---: | :---- |
| **Created By** | HungKT | **Created Date** |  16/06/2026 |
| **Primary Actors** | Guest | **Secondary Actors** | Google OAuth Provider |
| **Description** | As a registered Student or Teacher, I want to log in to the public learning platform using Google OAuth so that I can access features according to my role. |  |  |
| **Trigger** | A Student or Teacher clicks Continue with Google on the public login screen. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. A public user account already exists and is linked to verified Google email. 2\. The account is not locked, banned, or disabled. 3\. Google OAuth service is available or retry is possible. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | 1\. Authenticated public sessions are created. 2\. Role permissions are loaded. 3\. The user is redirected to the Student or Teacher dashboard. |  |  |
| **Normal Sequence/Flow** | The user opens the public login screen. User clicks Continue with Google. At Step 2, if the system detects that the Google account is not linked to any existing user record \-\> The system branches to UC-01 (Complete Google Account Onboarding)  The system redirects users to Google OAuth Provider. Google OAuth Provider returns verified identity information. System validates Google ID token and email verification claims. The system finds a linked ManabiHub public account. The system checks account status and role permissions. The system creates session token and records login audit log. The system redirects the user to the appropriate dashboard. |  |  |
| **Alternative Sequences/Flows** | 6a. No linked account exists \-\> System starts UC-01 Complete Google Account Onboarding. 9a. User logs out later \-\> System invalidates session and returns user to public home page. |  |  |
| **Exception** | 4a. Google login fails \-\> System displays MSG-AUTH-001 and allows retry. 5a. Token validation fails \-\> System denies login and logs security event. 6b. Linked account is not found and onboarding is disabled \-\> System denies access. 7a. Account is locked/banned/disabled \-\> System displays MSG-AUTH-003 and stops. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-AUTH-01, BR-AUTH-05, BR-AUTH-06, BR-AUTH-07, BR-AUTH-08, BR-AUTH-PUBLIC-01, BR-RBAC-01 |  |  |
| **Non-Functional Requirements** | NFR-SEC-02: Session token must be signed and expire after inactivity. NFR-PERF-01: Login response should be under 3 seconds excluding Google provider latency. NFR-UX-02: Error messages must be Vietnamese and must not expose internal token details. |  |  |
| **Priority** | Must Have |  |  |
| **MSG** | MSG-AUTH-001, MSG-AUTH-003 |  |  |

 

#### ***2.2.3 Login to Admin Portal (UC-03)*** {#2.2.3-login-to-admin-portal-(uc-03)}

*Table 2.4: Use case description of Login to Admin Portal*

| Use Case ID | UC-03 | Use Case Name | Login to Admin Portal |
| ----- | :---- | :---: | :---- |
| **Created By** | HungKT | **Created Date** |  16/06/2026 |
| **Primary Actors** | System Admin | **Secondary Actors** | None |
| **Description** | As a System Admin, I want to log in to a separate administration site using a pre-created username/email and password so that I can manage platform operations securely. |  |  |
| **Trigger** | System Admin opens the Admin Portal and submits admin credentials. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. Admin account has been created internally before login. 2\. The admin account is active and not locked. 3\. Admin Portal is reachable through the administration URL. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | 1\. Admin session is created successfully. 2\. Admin permissions are loaded. 3\. The login attempt is recorded in the audit/security log. |  |  |
| **Normal Sequence/Flow** | 1\. Admin opens the Admin Portal login page. 2\. Admin enters username/email and password. 3\. Admin clicks Login. 4\. The system validates required fields. 5\. System verifies submitted password against stored BCrypt/Argon2id hash. 6\. System checks admin account status, failed-attempt counter, and permissions. 7\. The system creates an admin session and records successful login. 8\. System redirects admin to Admin Dashboard. |  |  |
| **Alternative Sequences/Flows** | 2a. Admin uses email instead of username \-\> System resolves the matching pre-created admin account. 7a. Admin clicks Logout \-\> System invalidates admin session and returns to Admin Portal login. |  |  |
| **Exception** | 4a. Missing username/email or password \-\> System displays MSG-COM-002. 5a. Credential is invalid \-\> System displays MSG-AUTH-007 with generic error message. 5b. Repeated failed attempts exceed threshold \-\> System locks admin login temporarily and displays MSG-AUTH-008. 6a. Admin account is disabled \-\> System denies access and records security events. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-AUTH-03, BR-AUTH-04, BR-AUTH-06, BR-AUTH-07, BR-AUTH-09, BR-AUTH-ADMIN-01, BR-AUTH-ADMIN-02, BR-AUTH-ADMIN-03, BR-AUTH-ADMIN-04, BR-RBAC-01, BR-AUD-01 |  |  |
| **Non-Functional Requirements** | NFR-SEC-03: Admin passwords must never be stored in plaintext. NFR-SEC-04: Admin login must use generic failure messages and lockout/throttling. NFR-PERF-02: Admin login validation should complete within 3 seconds. |  |  |
| **Priority** | Must Have |  |  |
| **MSG** | MSG-COM-002, MSG-AUTH-007,  MSG-AUTH-008 |  |  |

The system saves valid changes and records audit logs for sensitive updates. 7\. The system displays MSG-PRO-001. |  |  |

#### ***2.3.4 Purchase Course (UC-08)*** {#2.3.4-purchase-course-(uc-08)}

*Table 2.9: Use case description of Purchase Course*

| Use Case ID | UC-08 | Use Case Name | Purchase Course |
| ----- | :---- | :---: | :---- |
| **Created By** | HuongDT | **Created Date** |  16/06/2026 |
| **Primary Actors** | Student | **Secondary Actors** | Payment Gateway, Notification Service |
| **Description** | As a Student, I want to purchase a product and receive access only after backend payment confirmation so that my enrollment is valid, secure, and correctly attributed for revenue sharing.  |  |  |
| **Trigger** | Students click Buy Now or Checkout for a course. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The student is logged in. 2\. The product is Published and available for new buyers. 3\. The student does not already own the product. 4\. Product price satisfies current platform price floor. 5\. Payment gateway integration is configured.  |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | 1\. Order/payment status is updated. 2\. Sale attribution is recorded as Teacher Referral or Platform Sale. 3\. Enrollment is created only after valid backend webhook confirmation. 4\. Escrow ledger, revenue share record, and course-based AI credits are created. 5\. Students receive purchase notification.  |  |  |
| **Normal Sequence/Flow** | 1\. The student opens Product Detail and clicks Buy Now or Checkout. 2\. The system checks product status, ownership, price floor, and student account status. 3\. Students enter or open checkout through a coupon/referral link if available. 4\. System validates coupon/referral attribution and determines sale source: Teacher Referral or Platform Sale. 5\. The system creates an Order with Pending Payment status and stores attribution snapshot. 6\. Student confirms payment method and payment information. 7\. The system sends payment requests to the Payment Gateway. 8\. Payment Gateway processes payment and sends a backend webhook. 9\. System verifies webhook signature, amount, order ID, idempotency key, and gateway reference. 10\. System updates Order to Paid, creates Enrollment Active, creates EscrowLedger Pending\_Clearing, calculates RevenueShare, and grants course AI credits in one database transaction. 11\. The system sends a purchase notification and shows the product in My Learning.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Sequences/Flows** | 4a. Coupon/referral is invalid or expired \-\> System rejects coupon and processes the order as Platform Sale if the student continues. 6a. Student cancels before payment \-\> System cancels or keeps order Pending until expiration and does not create enrollment. 8a. Gateway returns pending state \-\> System shows payment pending and waits for webhook. 10a. Order contains token package instead of course \-\> System updates AI credit balance without enrollment.  |  |  |
| **Exception** | 2a. The course is already owned \-\> System blocks purchase and shows Go to My Learning. 2b. Course is hidden/soft-deleted for new buyers \-\> System blocks checkout. 7a. Webhook signature or amount is invalid \-\> System rejects webhook and displays/records MSG-PAY-004. 8b. Database transaction fails \-\> System rolls back all payment-side effects and marks transaction Pending Review.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-PUR-01, BR-PUR-02, BR-PUR-03, BR-PAY-01, BR-PAY-02, BR-PAY-03, BR-PAY-04, BR-ESC-01, BR-ESC-03, BR-REVSHARE-01, BR-REVSHARE-02, BR-REVSHARE-03, BR-REVSHARE-04, BR-REVSHARE-05, BR-REVSHARE-06, BR-COUPON-01, BR-COUPON-02, BR-COUPON-03, BR-AI-03, BR-NOTIF-02  |  |  |
| **Non-Functional Requirements** | NFR-SEC-08: Payment confirmation must be backend-only and idempotent. NFR-REL-01: Payment, enrollment, escrow, and token updates must be ACID transactional. NFR-PERF-07: Payment result display should respond within 3 seconds excluding gateway delay.  |  |  |
| **Priority** | Must Have |  |  |
| **MSG** | MSG-PAY-004 |  |  |

| **Trigger** | Student clicks Submit Writing on a writing lesson block. |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. The Student is logged in. 2\. The Student has active enrollment for the course. 3\. The writing block belongs to the enrolled course. 4\. The course price is equal to or higher than the configured AI support price floor. 5\. AI writing assessment is enabled for the course.  |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | 1\. WritingSubmission is created in Processing status. 2\. AI assessment jobs are queued or sent. 3\. Students are notified when feedback is ready. |  |  |
| **Normal Sequence/Flow** | 1\. The student opens a writing lesson block. 2\. Students enter Japanese writing content. 3\. Student clicks Submit Writing. 4\. System checks enrollment, writing block ownership, content length, AI support price floor, and AI feature availability. 5\. If eligible, the system creates WritingSubmission with Processing status. 6\. The system sends writing content, lesson context, and JLPT rubric to the AI Provider asynchronously. 7\. AI Provider returns assessment result. 8\. The system stores AI scores, highlighted errors, rubric feedback, and comments. 9\. The system updates submission status and notifies Student.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Sequences/Flows** | 6a. AI provider does not support callback \-\> System polls job status until completion or timeout. 8a. Teacher review is required \-\> System changes status to Pending\_Teacher\_Review before final publication. |  |  |
| **Exception** | 4a. Student has no active enrollment \-\> System denies submission. 4b. Course is free or priced below AI support price floor \-\> System stores the writing submission without AI assessment or displays AI unavailable message. 6b. AI provider timeout \-\> System marks Retry\_Scheduled and retries according to policy. 7a. AI returns unsafe/empty result \-\> System marks Failed\_AI and sends fallback notification.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-WRITE-01, BR-WRITE-02, BR-WRITE-03, BR-WRITE-04, BR-AI-05, BR-AI-06, BR-AI-07, BR-NOTIF-02 |  |  |
| **Non-Functional Requirements** | NFR-REL-05: Writing submission must not be lost if AI processing fails. NFR-SEC-11: Students can submit only to the owned/enrolled writing block. NFR-UX-11: System must show Processing state for asynchronous assessment. |  |  |
| **Priority** | Must Have |  |  |

Teacher clicks Submit Verification. 8\. System validates required files, file type, file size, duplicate file hash, and agreement checkbox. 9\. The system stores files in restricted storage. 10\. The system sends identity documents and selfie/liveness data to VNPT eKYC Provider. 11\. VNPT eKYC Provider returns extracted identity data, face/liveness verification result, and risk result. 12\. System cross-checks certificate indicators against MockJLPTRegistry when certificate code is available. 13\. The system stores VNPT verification results and creates KYC Requests with Pending\_Admin\_Review. 14\. System notifies Admin review queue. 15\. The system displays MSG-KYC-003.  |  |  |

Teacher resubmits after rejection/correction request \-\> System preserves previous decision note, stores new file version, and creates a new KYC review attempt. 11a. VNPT result is low-risk \-\> System marks request as Low Risk in Admin review queue, but KYC status remains Pending\_Admin\_Review until Admin decision. 12a. Certificate code is not found in MockJLPTRegistry \-\> System marks request as Manual Verification Required for Admin review.  |  |  |
| **Exception** | 8a. Required file is missing or invalid \-\> System displays MSG-KYC-002. 8b. Duplicate identity document is detected \-\> System displays MSG-KYC-008, rejects the upload, and records a security event. 10a. VNPT verification fails or times out \-\> System displays MSG-KYC-009 and keeps KYC status Not\_Submitted or Resubmission\_Required. 12b. Identity/certificate data mismatch \-\> System displays MSG-KYC-006 and routes request to Pending\_Admin\_Review with High Risk. 4a. Teacher is permanently suspended for fraud \-\> System denies submission and displays MSG-ADM-002.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-KYC-01, BR-KYC-02, BR-KYC-03, BR-KYC-04, BR-KYC-05, BR-OWN-01, BR-NOTIF-02, BR-AUD-01, BR-AUD-03   |  |  |
| **Non-Functional Requirements** | NFR-SEC-19: KYC legal documents must be encrypted at rest and accessible only to authorized admins. NFR-PERF-22: VNPT eKYC request/callback handling should complete within 8 seconds excluding provider delay. NFR-EXT-01: External provider callbacks must be authenticated, validated, and idempotent. NFR-AUD-02: KYC decisions must be traceable.   |  |  |
| **Priority** | Must Have |  |  |
| **MSG** | MSG-KYC-003, MSG-KYC-002, MSG-KYC-008, MSG-KYC-009, MSG-KYC-006, MSG-ADM-002 |  |  |

| **Primary Actors** | System Admin | **Secondary Actors** | VNPT eKYC Provider, Notification Service  |
| **Description** | Enables System Admin to inspect Teacher KYC documents, VNPT eKYC verification results, certificate registry checks, risk level, and decision history to approve, reject, or request correction for a Teacher onboarding profile.   |  |  |
| **Trigger** | Admin selects a target processing queue row from the administrative KYC Pending Management bucket pool.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | 1\. System Admin is authenticated in the Admin Portal. 2\. Admin has KYC review permission. 3\. KYCRequest exists with Pending\_Admin\_Review status. 4\. VNPT eKYC verification result has been recorded.  |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | 1\. KYCRequest status becomes Approved, Rejected, or Resubmission\_Required. 2\. Teacher account capabilities are recalibrated. Approved KYC unlocks product authoring features; other outcomes keep them locked. 3\. Decision notes and audit logs are stored. 4\. The teacher receives decision notification.  |  |  |
| **Normal Sequence/Flow** | 1\. Admin opens the KYC Review queue. 2\. The system displays pending KYC requests. 3\. Admin opens one Teacher Verification Detail page. 4\. The system displays Teacher profile, uploaded documents, selfie/liveness result, copyright agreement, VNPT verification result, certificate registry check, risk level, and previous decision history. 5\. Admin reviews evidence and risk indicators. 6\. Admin selects Approve, Reject, or Request Correction. 7\. The system requires a decision note for Reject or Request Correction. 8\. System updates KYC status, locks verified records when approved, records audit log, and notifies Teacher.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Sequences/Flows** | 6a. Approve \-\> KYC status becomes Approved and product authoring features are unlocked. 6b. Reject \-\> KYC status becomes Rejected and product authoring remains locked. 6c. Request Correction \-\> KYC status becomes Resubmission\_Required and product authoring remains locked. 6d. Certificate code is missing but images show no digital alteration \-\> Admin requests correction or marks the request for manual verification note; KYC remains not approved until final decision.  |  |  |
| **Exception** | 7a. Missing rejection/correction reason \-\> System blocks decision and displays MSG-COM-002. 4a. KYC record no longer exists or already processed \-\> System shows unavailable state. 8a. Update fails \-\> System keeps previous status and displays MSG-COM-004.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-KYC-01, BR-KYC-02, BR-KYC-03, BR-KYC-04, BR-KYC-05, BR-RBAC-04, BR-NOTIF-02, BR-AUD-01, BR-AUD-03  |  |  |
| **Non-Functional Requirements** | NFR-AUD-02: Immutable logging of administrator KYC decisions. NFR-SEC-19: KYC documents must be protected at rest and access-controlled. NFR-UX-32: Admin must see VNPT result and risk level before deciding.  |  |  |
| **Priority** | Must Have |  |  |
| **MSG** | MSG-COM-002, MSG-COM-004 |  |  |

System records settlement log and notifies Teacher. |  |  |
| **Alternative Sequences/Flows** | 2a. Reconciliation alert exists \-\> Admin opens alert detail before settlement. 6a. Manual bank transfer is used \-\> Admin uploads transaction proof and marks settlement completed. 4a. Admin rejects payout \-\> Reserved amount returns to Teacher Available Balance. |  |  |
| **Exception** | 5a. Teacher balance is frozen \-\> System blocks payout. 5b. Available balance is insufficient \-\> System rejects settlement. 5c. Critical reconciliation mismatch exists \-\> System displays MSG-ADM-005 and blocks payout. 6b. Gateway transfer fails \-\> System marks payout Failed/Pending Retry. 7a. Ledger update fails \-\> System rolls back and alerts admin. |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-PAYOUT-01, BR-PAYOUT-02, BR-PAYOUT-03, BR-WAL-01, BR-WAL-02, BR-WAL-03, BR-ESC-02, BR-RBAC-04, BR-NOTIF-02, BR-AUD-01 |  |  |
| **Non-Functional Requirements** | NFR-REL-12: Payout settlement must be idempotent and transactional. NFR-SEC-30: Payout requires finance permission and audit log. NFR-UX-30: Admin must see reconciliation status before approving payout. |  |  |
| **Priority** | Must Have |  |  |
| **MSG** | MSG-ADM-005 |  |  |

 

 

### **2.8 Lesson Content & Interaction Block Management**  {#2.8-lesson-content-&-interaction-block-management}

#### ***2.8.1 Configure Lesson Blocks (UC-34)*** {#2.8.1-configure-lesson-blocks-(uc-34)}

*Table 2.35: Use case description of* Configure Lesson Blocks

| Use Case ID | UC-34 | Use Case Name | Configure Lesson Blocks  |
| ----- | :---- | :---: | :---- |
| **Created By** |  LongPD | **Created Date** |  16/06/2026 |
| **Primary Actors** | Teacher | **Secondary Actors** | None |
| **Description** | Enables a Teacher with Approved KYC to configure video, text, quiz, flashcard, and writing blocks inside lessons, and to configure Final Test questions, answer keys, explanations, scoring rule, retake policy, and time limit for course completion. |  |  |
| **Trigger** | The teacher clicks the "Add Content Block" button or selects an existing block node inside a specified lesson frame.  |  |  |
| **Preconditions** | The teacher is authenticated and the session token is active. Teacher KYC status is **Approved**. Target lesson belongs to a course owned by the current Teacher. The parent course is strictly in Draft or Validation\_Failed state. |  |  |
| **Postconditions** | 1\. Lesson blocksquestion banks are created, updated, reordered, imported, or removed. 2\. Block/question validation result is updated. 3\. Product validation status is recalculated. 4\. Changes are audit logged.  |  |  |
| **Normal Sequence/Flow** | 1\. The teacher opens a Video Course lesson editor. 2\. System verifies KYC Approved, ownership, and editable status. 3\. For Video Course, Teacher selects block type: Video, Text, Quiz, Flashcard, or Writing. 4\. The teacher configures the selected block. 5\. For the Video block, the Teacher uploads media and optional transcripts. 6\. For the Text block, the Teacher enters explanation content. 7\. For the Quiz block, the teacher enters questions, choices, correct answers, and explanations. 8\. For the Flashcard block, the teacher enters vocabulary/Kanji cards or imports CSV. 9\. For the Writing block, the Teacher enters the prompt and selects the writing rubric. 10\. For Final Test, Teacher creates test sections, questions, answer keys, explanations, scoring rule, retake policy, and time limit. 11\. The teacher reorders blocks or questions if needed. 12\. The teacher clicks Save Content. 13\. System validates block/question integrity, long-video rule, duplicate flashcards/questions, quiz answer key, writing rubric, Final Test question count, scoring configuration, and JLPT/skill mapping. 14\. The system saves content and displays MSG-COURSE-001.  |  |  |
| **Alternative Sequences/Flows** | 8a. Flashcard CSV Import \-\> System parses rows, shows preview, and commits valid cards. 10a. Final Test question import \-\> System previews imported questions and rejects invalid rows. 11a. Drag-and-drop reorder \-\> System updates block/question order atomically. 11b. Remove block/question \-\> System asks confirmation and recalculates validation.  |  |  |
| **Exception** | 2a. KYC not Approved \-\> System displays MSG-KYC-010. 13a. Video \> 15 minutes without immediate interaction block \-\> System displays MSG-COURSE-009. 13b. Duplicate flashcards \-\> System displays MSG-COURSE-010. 13c. Quiz lacks answer key \-\> System displays MSG-COURSE-013. 13d. Writing lacks rubric \-\> System displays MSG-WRITE-005. 13e. Final Test lacks minimum questions \-\> System displays MSG-FTEST-001. 13f. Final Test question lacks answer or explanation \-\> System displays MSG-FTEST-002. 13g. Final Test scoring is missing \-\> System displays MSG-FTEST-003. 13h. Duplicate Final Test question \-\> System displays MSG-FTEST-004. 2b. Ownership mismatch \-\> System displays MSG-ADM-002 and logs security events.  |  |  |
| **Business Rules** | BR-PROD-03, BR-PROD-04, BR-PROD-05, BR-KYC-02, BR-OWN-01, BR-CRS-02, BR-CRS-03, BR-CONTENT-01, BR-CONTENT-02, BR-CONTENT-03, BR-CONTENT-04, BR-FTEST-01, BR-FTEST-02, BR-FTEST-03, BR-FTEST-04, BR-FTEST-05, BR-AUD-01  |  |  |
| **Non-Functional Requirements** | NFR-PERF-17: Block state serialization latency should complete within 2 seconds excluding file upload. NFR-PERF-18: CSV structural parsing should complete within 3 seconds for normal template size. NFR-SEC-20: Block and question APIs must enforce KYC and ownership server-side.  |  |  |
| **Priority** | Must Have |  |  |
| **MSG** | MSG-COURSE-001, MSG-KYC-010, MSG-COURSE-009, MSG-COURSE-010, MSG-COURSE-013, MSG-WRITE-005 |  |  |

#### ***3.1.4 Non-UI Functions***

| ID | Rule Name | Description | Related UC |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **NUI-DOM-01** | Japanese Learning Evidence Validation | Validates structured Japanese learning evidence (grammar, vocabulary, quiz, etc.). Blocks submission if below threshold. | UC-23, UC-34 |
| **NUI-VID-01** | Long Video Interaction Check | Requires an interactive block (Quiz, Flashcard, or Writing) after any video \> 15 minutes. | UC-34 |
| **NUI-FTEST-01** | Final Test Configuration Validator | Validates Final Test questions, answer keys, passing scores, and policies. | UC-23 |
| **NUI-FTEST-02** | Final Test Unlock Eligibility Checker | Ensures 100% progress and minimum 85% average score before unlocking Final Test. | UC-12 |
| **NUI-CERT-01** | Certificate Eligibility Checker | Generates certificate only after progress, assignment, and test requirements are met. | UC-11 |
| **NUI-AI-01** | AI Course Eligibility Gate | Checks enrollment, block ownership, and price thresholds for AI feature access. | UC-14, UC-16 |
| **NUI-AI-02** | AI Chatbot Scope Guardrail | Restricts queries to current context, blocks unsafe content, and logs usage. | UC-16 |
| **NUI-AI-03** | Async Writing Assessment Pipeline | Asynchronously processes writing submissions via AI provider. | UC-14, UC-15 |
| **NUI-ESC-01** | Item-level Escrow Clearing Job | Daily job to release funds to Teacher balance after 14 days if no disputes exist. | UC-27 |
| **NUI-REF-01** | Auto-Refund Eligibility Evaluator | Auto-approves refunds if \< 14 days and \< 20% progress; otherwise triggers manual review. | UC-18, UC-32 |
| **NUI-PAY-01** | Webhook Verification & Order Update | Verifies secure callbacks from Payment Gateway and updates system records. | UC-08 |

| System Notice Banner | An informational banner noting that changes to the "AI Quota" apply on the next daily reset, and "Price Floor" changes only affect newly created or approved courses. |
| Revenue & Allocation \- Platform Commission Rate | An input field to set the percentage of course revenue retained by the platform (e.g., 30%). |
| Revenue & Allocation \- Course Price Floor | An input field to define the minimum allowable price for a paid course (e.g., 50,000 VND). |
| Revenue & Allocation \- Minimum Withdrawal Limit | An input field to specify the minimum available balance required for a teacher to submit a withdrawal request (e.g., 500,000 VND). |
| AI Token Limits & Pricing \- AI Free Quota / Day | An input field configuring the number of free AI tokens granted to each student daily (e.g., 100 Tokens). |
| AI Token Limits & Pricing \- AI Token Package Price | An input field to set the purchase price for an add-on package of 1000 AI Tokens (e.g., 20,000 VND). |
| Refund Policy \- Request Time Limit | An input field setting the maximum number of days after purchase during which a student can request a refund (e.g., 7 Days). |
| Refund Policy \- Max Progress Limit | An input field defining the maximum course completion percentage allowed for a refund to remain eligible (e.g., 20%). |
| Security Policy \- Login Attempt Limit | An input field setting the maximum number of consecutive failed login attempts before an account is temporarily locked (e.g., 5 Times). |
| Security Policy \- Login Session Timeout | An input field specifying the maximum inactivity duration in minutes before a user is automatically logged out (e.g., 120 Minutes). |

## **4\. Non-Functional Requirements** {#4.-non-functional-requirements}

### **4.1 External Interfaces** {#4.1-external-interfaces}

#### ***4.1.1 External Service Integration*** {#4.1.1-external-service-integration}

The system shall integrate with the following external services:

* Payment Gateway  for tuition and course payments.  
* OpenAI API for AI-assisted content generation.  
* Cloudinary for media and document storage.  
* Google OAuth 2.0 for third-party authentication.  
* Email services for account verification and notifications.

#### ***4.1.2 Communication Protocols*** {#4.1.2-communication-protocols}

* Client-server communication shall be performed using HTTPS.  
* Real-time notifications shall use WebSocket (STOMP over SockJS).  
* Long Polling shall be activated automatically when WebSocket connections fail.

### **4.2 Quality Attributes** {#4.2-quality-attributes}

#### ***4.2.1 Usability***  {#4.2.1-usability}

##### **4.2.1.1 Learnability** {#4.2.1.1-learnability}

* Student \- Course Enrollment: Maximum 4 steps to browse details and initiate enrollment.  
* Student \- Placement Test: Maximum 3 steps to access and begin the assessment.  
* Student \- Learning: Maximum 4 steps to access purchased content and start a lesson.  
* Student \- Deferral: Maximum 5 steps to submit a study deferral request.  
* Teacher \- Course Creation: Maximum 5 steps to create a course draft.  
* Teacher \- AI Content: Maximum 7 steps to upload materials and generate AI-assisted content.  
* Manager \- Approval: Maximum 4 steps to review and approve a pending course.

A navigation step is defined as a user action that transitions between screens or completes a major interaction.

##### **4.2.1.2 Error Handling & Prevention** {#4.2.1.2-error-handling-&-prevention}

* The system shall display Vietnamese error messages for payment failures, upload failures, and network interruptions.  
* The system shall display loading indicators during AI content generation.  
* Timeout conditions shall be handled gracefully through retry mechanisms and controlled error messages.  
* WebSocket failures shall automatically trigger Long Polling mode.  
* Error messages shall not expose internal system information.

##### **4.2.1.3 Accessibility** {#4.2.1.3-accessibility}

* Minimum text contrast ratio: 4.5:1.  
* All form inputs shall include visible labels.  
* Validation messages shall be displayed near the related input field.  
* Minimum font size shall be 14px (web) and 14sp (mobile).  
* Interactive elements shall provide hover and focus states.  
* Responsive layouts shall support desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

#### ***4.2.2 Performance*** {#4.2.2-performance}

##### **4.2.2.1 Response Time** {#4.2.2.1-response-time}

Response time is measured from backend request reception until response delivery, excluding external service latency.

* Page navigation: ≤ 2 seconds.  
* Login, registration, enrollment, and payment APIs: ≤ 3 seconds.  
* Learning progress synchronization: ≤ 2 seconds.  
* Dashboard statistics generation: ≤ 5 seconds.  
* AI content processing (excluding OpenAI latency): ≤ 3 seconds.  
* File upload operations: ≤ 30 seconds.

##### **4.2.2.2 Throughput** {#4.2.2.2-throughput}

* The system shall support at least 100 concurrent active users.  
* The system shall support at least 30 concurrent video streaming sessions.  
* The system shall support at least 20 simultaneous AI generation requests.

##### **4.2.2.3 Notification Performance** {#4.2.2.3-notification-performance}

* WebSocket notifications shall be delivered within 2 seconds.  
* Long Polling notifications shall be delivered within 30 seconds.  
* Supported notifications include payment confirmations, deferral requests, course approvals, and complaints.

## **5\. Requirement Appendix**

### **5.1 Business Rules** {#5.1-business-rules}

| Rule ID | Rule Definition |
| :---- | :---- |
| BR-AUTH-01 | Public Student and Teacher accounts in the MVP are created and accessed through verified Google OAuth. The system does not store public user passwords. |
| BR-AUTH-02 | A first-time Google user must complete role onboarding and select Student or Teacher before the account becomes active. |
| BR-AUTH-03 | System Admin must log in through a separate Admin Portal using a pre-created administrator account. Admin accounts are not created through public onboarding. |
| BR-AUTH-04 | Admin password hashes must be stored using BCrypt or Argon2id. Plain-text admin passwords must never be stored. |
| BR-AUTH-05 | Each verified Google email can be linked to only one active public ManabiHub account. |
| BR-AUTH-06 | Locked, banned, or disabled accounts cannot log in even when Google or admin credentials are valid. |
| BR-AUTH-07 | User sessions must expire after the configured inactivity period. Logout must invalidate the current session token. |
| BR-AUTH-08 | Google ID token, issuer, audience, and email verification claims must be validated server-side before public login or account creation. |
| BR-AUTH-09 | Admin Portal must apply login attempt throttling or temporary lockout after repeated failed password attempts. |
| BR-AUTH-ADMIN-01 | System Admin accounts must be created internally before login; Admin accounts cannot be created through public Google onboarding. |
| BR-AUTH-ADMIN-02 | System Admin must log in through the separate Admin Portal using username/email and password. |
| BR-AUTH-ADMIN-03 | Admin passwords must be stored as secure hashes using BCrypt or Argon2id; plaintext passwords must never be stored. |
| BR-AUTH-ADMIN-04 | Admin login must use generic error messages and temporary lockout after repeated failed attempts. |
| BR-AUTH-PUBLIC-01 | Student and Teacher accounts must use verified Google OAuth identity for public-site authentication in the MVP. |
| BR-RBAC-01 | Every protected function requires an authenticated session and a valid role permission. |
| BR-RBAC-02 | Students can access only their own enrollment, wishlist, purchase, refund, writing, notification, and token records. |
| BR-RBAC-03 | Teachers can access only their own products, course analytics, writing submissions, wallet, and withdrawal records. |
| BR-RBAC-04 | System Admin can review KYC, moderate content, configure policies, handle disputes, reconcile finance, execute payouts, and manage account status. |
| BR-PROD-01 | ManabiHub supports exactly two teacher product types in the MVP: Video Course and Final Test. Product type must be selected at the first step of product creation and cannot be changed after submission for Admin review. |
| BR-PROD-02 | A Video Course is a structured learning product that may contain video, text, quiz, flashcard, writing assignment, and downloadable learning materials. |
| BR-PROD-03 | A Final Test is a quiz-only product designed for exam preparation. It does not require video lessons but must contain a valid question bank, answer key, explanation, JLPT level, time limit, passing score, and retake policy. |
| BR-PROD-04 | Teachers must have Approved KYC before accessing product creation, product editing, product saving, lesson block configuration, product submission, or product publication. |
| BR-PROD-05 | A product created by a Teacher must be owned by that Teacher account. Teachers can create, view, edit, archive, submit, publish, or unpublish only products owned by their own Teacher account. |
| BR-PROD-06 | Product title cannot be changed after the product has at least one paid enrollment, except through an Admin-approved revision request. This prevents misleading students after purchase. |
| BR-PROD-07 | A product with zero paid enrollments may be permanently deleted by its owning Teacher. A product with one or more paid enrollments cannot be permanently deleted and can only be unpublished/hidden from new buyers. |
| BR-PROD-08 | Unpublished products are hidden from new buyers but remain accessible to Students who already purchased them, unless the product is suspended due to confirmed legal or safety decisions. |
| BR-GOAL-01 | Before adding lesson or test content, the teacher must define product learning goals. A product must contain at least four learning goals. |
| BR-GOAL-02 | Each learning goal must be specific, student-facing, and no longer than 160 characters. Empty, duplicated, or meaningless goals are rejected. |
| BR-GOAL-03 | The teacher must define product prerequisites before submitting the product for review. If no prerequisite is required, Teacher must explicitly mark No prerequisite required. |
| BR-GOAL-04 | Teachers must define target students before submitting the product for review. Target student description must explain who should take the product and what learning needs it serves. |
| BR-GOAL-05 | Learning goals, prerequisites, and target student descriptions are displayed on the product sales page. These fields must pass validation before Admin review. |
| BR-KYC-01 | Teacher KYC submission must include CCCD/front-back identity documents, professional or JLPT certificate, selfie/liveness data, and Digital Copyright Liability Agreement. |
| BR-KYC-02 | Teachers must have Approved KYC before accessing course structure creation, course structure editing, lesson block configuration, product submission, and publication. |
| BR-KYC-03 | Rejected or Resubmission Required KYC allows resubmission but does not unlock product authoring features. |
| BR-KYC-04 | Each KYC request must include VNPT eKYC verification results before entering Admin final review. |
| BR-KYC-05 | VNPT eKYC results cannot approve KYC automatically. System Admin must make the final KYC decision. |
| BR-OWN-01 | Teachers can create, view, edit, save, archive, submit, publish, and unpublish only products owned by their own Teacher account. |
| BR-COURSE-01 | A newly created product must be saved as Draft and owned by the creating Teacher. |
| BR-COURSE-02 | Draft, Rejected, Hidden, Force-Draft, or Suspended products must not be visible to new buyers in the public catalog. |
| BR-COURSE-03 | Only the owning Teacher can edit the product draft, modules, lessons, question banks, quiz blocks, and flashcard blocks. |
| BR-COURSE-04 | Product metadata must include title, JLPT level, introduction, outcomes, thumbnail, category, and price before publication review. |
| BR-COURSE-05 | Product price must be greater than or equal to the platform price floor configured by System Admin. |
| BR-COURSE-06 | A teaching video block longer than the configured limit must be followed by or paired with an interaction block. |
| BR-COURSE-07 | Product status must follow Draft \-\> Pending Approval \-\> Approved/Rejected \-\> Published/Hidden/Force-Draft/Suspended. |
| BR-COURSE-08 | Students who purchased a product keep access to owned content when the product is hidden or soft-deleted for new buyers, unless restricted by confirmed legal or safety decisions. |
| BR-COURSE-09 | A purchased product cannot be hard-deleted because purchase is treated as a digital ownership contract. |
| BR-CRS-01 | A Video Course must follow the hierarchy: Course \-\> Module \-\> Lesson \-\> Block. A course must contain at least one Module, each Module must contain at least one Lesson, and each Lesson must contain at least one content or interaction Block. |
| BR-CRS-02 | Each Video Course must declare a JLPT level: N5, N4, N3, N2, N1, or General. Each lesson must contain Japanese learning evidence such as grammar, vocabulary, Kanji, example sentence, quiz, flashcard, writing task, or explanation content. |
| BR-CRS-03 | A video block longer than 15 minutes must be followed by at least one interaction block: Quiz, Flashcard, or Writing Assignment. |
| BR-CRS-04 | Published products cannot be edited directly. Any content change after publication must be handled through a revision draft and must pass validation and Admin approval again. |
| BR-CRS-05 | A Video Course must contain at least five separate lessons before it can be submitted for Admin review. |
| BR-CRS-06 | A Video Course must contain at least 30 minutes of total video duration before it can be submitted for Admin review. |
| BR-CRS-07 | All mandatory video lessons in a Video Course must meet the minimum HD quality requirement of 720p before publication approval. |
| BR-CRS-08 | The teacher must provide a test video before the first Video Course can be approved. The test video must be between 1 and 3 minutes and must be reviewed by Admin for image clarity, lighting, audio quality, and teaching delivery. |
| BR-CRS-09 | A Video Course cannot be approved if its test video is rejected or not submitted. |
| BR-FTEST-01 | A Final Test must contain at least one test section and at least twenty active questions before it can be submitted for Admin review. |
| BR-FTEST-02 | Each Final Test question must have a question stem, answer options, exactly one correct answer or a clearly defined accepted answer set, and an explanation. |
| BR-FTEST-03 | Each Final Test must declare JLPT level and tested skill focus such as vocabulary, grammar, Kanji, reading, listening, or mixed practice. |
| BR-FTEST-04 | Final Test scoring configuration must define total score, passing score, time limit, and whether students can retake the test. |
| BR-FTEST-05 | Duplicate questions inside the same Final Test are not allowed. |
| BR-CONTENT-01 | Lesson block type must be one of: Video, Text, Quiz, Flashcard, or Writing. |
| BR-CONTENT-02 | Quiz blocks must contain at least one question, valid answer choices, and a correct answer key. |
| BR-CONTENT-03 | Flashcard blocks must not contain duplicate cards within the same flashcard set. |
| BR-CONTENT-04 | Writing blocks must include a prompt and an evaluation rubric before they can be saved as valid blocks. |
| BR-MKT-01 | Only Published and visible products can appear in the course catalog for Guests and new buyers. |
| BR-MKT-02 | Guests can search and view public product information only; they cannot wishlist, purchase, use AI, submit writing, review, refund, or report until logged in where applicable. |
| BR-WISH-01 | Only Students can manage their own wishlist. |
| BR-WISH-02 | A Student cannot save the same product to their wishlist more than once. |
| BR-PUR-01 | Only logged-in Students can purchase products. |
| BR-PUR-02 | A Student cannot purchase the same product twice. |
| BR-PUR-03 | Enrollment is created only after valid backend payment confirmation, not after client-side payment redirection alone. |
| BR-PAY-01 | A payment order must be created with Pending Payment status before a payment request is sent. |
| BR-PAY-02 | Payment webhook signature, amount, order ID, and gateway reference must be verified before processing. |
| BR-PAY-03 | Duplicate webhook events must not create duplicate enrollments, token credits, escrow entries, revenue-share records, or notifications. |
| BR-PAY-04 | Payment, enrollment, escrow, revenue-share, and token-grant updates must be committed in one database transaction. |
| BR-COUPON-01 | Teachers can create referral coupons only for products owned by their own Teacher account. |
| BR-COUPON-02 | A coupon must have a valid code, discount value, start date, end date, usage limit, and linked Teacher/product owner. |
| BR-COUPON-03 | Expired, disabled, over-limit, or mismatched coupons must be rejected during checkout. |
| BR-REVSHARE-01 | Every paid order must store sale attribution source: Teacher Referral or Platform Sale. |
| BR-REVSHARE-02 | Teacher Referral sale is identified when the order is created through a valid Teacher referral link or Teacher coupon code. |
| BR-REVSHARE-03 | Platform Sale is identified when the order is created through ManabiHub catalog search, platform promotion, paid advertising, or without a valid Teacher referral identifier. |
| BR-REVSHARE-04 | For Teacher Referral sales, Teacher receives 97% of net revenue and ManabiHub receives 3% of net revenue. |
| BR-REVSHARE-05 | For Platform Sales, Teacher receives 37% of net revenue and ManabiHub receives 63% of net revenue. |
| BR-REVSHARE-06 | Revenue share must be calculated from net revenue after payment gateway fee, refund, chargeback, and platform-discount adjustment. |
| BR-ESC-01 | Paid order revenue is first recorded as Pending Clearing in the escrow ledger. |
| BR-ESC-02 | Teacher revenue becomes Available Balance only after the configured 14-day clearing period and no blocking refund, dispute, freeze, or policy decision. |
| BR-ESC-03 | Platform commission and teacher share must be calculated from current system configuration at payment time. |
| BR-AI-01 | Guest users cannot use AI Chatbot or AI Writing features in the MVP. |
| BR-AI-02 | Logged-in Students may receive a limited free AI chat quota for trial usage according to configuration. |
| BR-AI-03 | Course purchase may grant course-based AI credits proportional to course value and platform policy. |
| BR-AI-04 | Token top-up increases AI credits only after verified payment webhook confirmation. |
| BR-AI-05 | AI requests must be blocked when the user has no remaining eligible quota or credits. |
| BR-AI-06 | AI usage must be logged and credits must be deducted only according to the configured success/failure policy. |
| BR-AI-07 | AI-generated explanations and writing feedback must show a learning-support disclaimer. |
| BR-WRITE-01 | Writing submission requires active enrollment in the product that owns the writing block. |
| BR-WRITE-02 | AI writing credits are reserved or deducted when a writing assessment job is accepted for processing. |
| BR-WRITE-03 | AI writing feedback is preliminary until the Teacher finalizes or accepts it when teacher review is required. |
| BR-WRITE-04 | Students can view only their own writing submissions and feedback. |
| BR-REV-01 | Only Students who purchased or historically owned the product can create or edit a review. |
| BR-REV-02 | A Student can have only one active review per product. |
| BR-REV-03 | Review rating must be within the configured range and comments must pass content validation. |
| BR-REV-04 | The system should request a course review from Student when the Student reaches at least 20% learning progress, but Student review submission remains optional. |
| BR-CERT-01 | A completion certificate can be generated only when a student reaches 100% required product progress and all mandatory assessments are completed according to product configuration. |
| BR-LRN-01 | Video learning progress must save the last valid watched position so the student can resume from the correct timestamp. |
| BR-LRN-02 | Lesson completion for video lessons requires at least 90% valid video watch progress unless the lesson is marked as non-mandatory preview content. |
| BR-REP-01 | Logged-in Students and Teachers may report product/content violations. |
| BR-REP-02 | The system must prevent duplicate or spam violation reports within a configured time window. |
| BR-REP-03 | Only System Admin can resolve violation reports and apply moderation actions. |
| BR-REF-01 | Auto-refund is eligible only when purchase age is within 14 days, learning progress does not exceed 20%, and students have not downloaded all protected learning materials. |
| BR-REF-02 | Refund requests outside auto-eligible conditions become disputes or pending manual review. |
| BR-REF-03 | A paid order cannot have duplicate active refund requests. |
| BR-REF-04 | Approved refunds must update refund status, enrollment access, escrow ledger, teacher wallet, and revenue-share records consistently. |
| BR-WAL-01 | Teacher withdrawal can be requested only from Available Balance, not Pending Clearing balance. |
| BR-WAL-02 | Withdrawal amount must satisfy the minimum payout threshold and not exceed available balance. |
| BR-WAL-03 | Frozen teacher balance or locked teacher account blocks withdrawal. |
| BR-PAYOUT-01 | Only System Admin with finance permission can execute payout settlement. |
| BR-PAYOUT-02 | Payout cannot be executed if reconciliation has unresolved critical mismatch. |
| BR-PAYOUT-03 | All payout decisions and settlement references must be stored in settlement logs. |
| BR-PAYOUT-04 | ManabiHub executes teacher payout settlement on a fixed monthly payout date configured by System Admin. |
| BR-NOTIF-01 | Users can view only notifications sent to their own account or permitted role. |
| BR-NOTIF-02 | Important workflow events must create notifications: KYC decision, product decision, purchase, feedback ready, refund decision, withdrawal decision, and moderation decision. |
| BR-ADM-01 | System setting changes must be validated and audit logged. |
| BR-ADM-02 | Invalid commission, revenue-share, price floor, quota, refund, escrow, payout, or validation setting values must be rejected. |
| BR-APP-01 | Admin approval for Teacher onboarding and product publication are separate control gates. KYC approval unlocks Teacher authoring permissions, while product approval allows an individual product to be published by Teacher. |
| BR-APP-02 | Admin must review submitted product metadata, goals, prerequisites, target students, technical validation result, content structure, and policy compliance before approving publication. |
| BR-APP-03 | Admin may approve or reject a submitted product. Rejected products return to Teacher for correction and cannot be published until resubmitted and approved. |
| BR-APP-04 | Admin does not publish a product directly. After Admin approval, Teacher must publish the approved product to make it visible in the marketplace. |
| BR-AUD-01 | Sensitive operations must be recorded in audit logs. |
| BR-AUD-02 | Unauthorized access attempts to another user’s private resource must be rejected and logged as a security event. |
| BR-AUD-03 | Product approval, KYC decision, refund decision, revenue-share calculation, escrow release, and payout settlement must store actor, timestamp, target record, decision, and reason. |
